study: SRT-H autonomous cholecystectomy (Kim et al., Science Robotics 2025)

convention.elementwise_note: Two operations for a normalization affine transform and one for the nonlinearity, applied once per produced activation element of every counted linear/convolution layer. Attention adds one operation per score element for the softmax. This is an arithmetic convention, not a kernel measurement.

high_level_policy.source: arXiv:2505.10251v2 'Model architecture' (HL), 'Inference' (HL), Supplementary 'High-level policy training configuration'
high_level_policy.views_note: Each endoscope frame is preprocessed into a 224x224 global view and a 224x224 resize of the fixed 432x480 center crop.

decoder.d_model_basis: Not published. Pinned by inverting the reported 16M shared by the Transformer decoder and MLP heads: a 6-layer decoder with 8d^2 + 2*d*ffn parameters per layer gives 14.2M at d=384/ffn=1536 and 25.2M at d=512/ffn=2048.

low_level_policy.source: arXiv:2505.10251v2 'Model architecture' (LL), 'Training' (LL), 'Inference' (LL); configuration lineage from arXiv:2407.12998v1 Table 3 and arXiv:2403.12910v1 Section IV-B

film.note: One scale/shift generator per MBConv block output, driven by the DistilBERT sentence embedding, following the RT-1 FiLM-EfficientNet construction adopted by YAY Robot.

action_transformer.name: ACT (action chunking with transformers)
action_transformer.extra_encoder_tokens_note: ACT prepends a style-variable token and a proprioception token to the flattened visual features. The training-only variational encoder is not executed at inference.
action_transformer.basis: Not published in the SRT-H paper. Taken from the same first author's dVRK predecessor (arXiv:2407.12998v1 Table 3: 4 encoder layers, 7 decoder layers, feedforward 3200, hidden 512) and cross-checked against the reported 72M low-level total.

task_instructions_verbatim: going back from the first clip left tube
going to the cutting position on the right tube
corrective_instructions_verbatim: move left arm to the left
move left arm to the right
move left arm away from me
move right arm to the left
move right arm to the right
move right arm away from me
instructions.note: The paper does not publish the full list of 17 task instructions. These are the task instructions quoted verbatim in the main text and Fig. 2B, and the complete list of 18 corrective instructions from the Supplementary Methods.

work_units.label: Complete clipping-and-cutting phase, 17 tasks
work_units.grasp_phase_fraction_basis: One of the 17 tasks is 'grabbing gallbladder', the only phase the paper gives a 30-step execution horizon. Its share of the recorded duration is not published; 1/17 is an equal-share allocation.
work_units.ai_duration_s_basis: Table 1 mean over the eight recorded procedures. Not in the deposit, which covers Fig. 6 only.

work_units.label: Apply the first clip to the cystic artery
Apply the third clip to the cystic artery
Go to the cutting position on the cystic artery
work_units.deposit_task_label: go to the cutting position right tube

human_durations_s.basis: Derived from the deposit records named in work_units, not read off Fig. 6C. The figure's integers are those values rounded.

scenarios.hl_frame_cache_note: Consecutive high-level calls are 3 s apart over five frames spaced 1 s apart, so two of the five are shared with the previous call. Caching those embeddings re-encodes three frames in two views, six passes, while the decoder still attends to all 490 memory tokens.

deposit.duration_rule: (samples - 1) / 30. The paper samples both video and kinematic streams at 30 FPS; elapsed time over n samples is (n-1)/30. Taking n/30 adds 0.033 s to every duration and changes no row by more than 0.2%.
deposit.position_units: metres; trajectory length is reported in millimetres
